purpose: Focused independent Spark reference capture for #901 lifecycle regressions. Input only; no expected outcomes.

definitions.sql: SELECT row_id,rand(7) AS r7_left,rand(7) AS r7_right,rand(8) AS r8 FROM rand901_one
definitions.purpose: Independent equal-seed occurrences and a separate seed-8 stream.

definitions.sql: SELECT row_id,rand(7) AS r FROM rand901_one
definitions.purpose: Collect twice from the same DataFrame and query execution without persistence.

definitions.sql: SELECT row_id,rand(7) AS r FROM rand_partitioned
definitions.purpose: Observe direct RAND on explicit source partitions [0,1,2,3] and [4,5,6,7]. The separate provider debug receipt records partition IDs.

definitions.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM rand901_one GROUP BY floor(rand(7)*2)
definitions.purpose: Observe group sizes without an unrelated nondeterministic grouped-output admission check.

definitions.sql: SELECT row_id,row_number() OVER (ORDER BY rand(7)) AS rn FROM rand901_one
SELECT row_id,lag(rand(7),1) OVER (ORDER BY row_id) AS previous_r FROM rand901_one
definitions.purpose: Observe random window input with stable row-id ordering.

definitions.sql: SELECT row_id FROM rand901_one WHERE rand(7) > 0.5
definitions.purpose: Observe a retained simple seeded random filter predicate.

definitions.sql: SELECT row_id,concat(s,CAST(CASE WHEN row_id = 1 THEN rand(7) ELSE rand(8) END AS STRING)) AS r FROM rand901_one
definitions.purpose: Observe selected CASE occurrences beneath the existing left-to-right CONCAT NULL guard.

comparison_contract.native_input_partitions: Exactly the authored partitions, including row order within each partition. Do not distribute record batches round-robin across these partitions.
comparison_contract.native_batch_layouts: Vary record-batch boundaries inside each fixed partition: [4], [1,1,1,1], [2,2], with optional empty batches. Keep complete raw results.
comparison_contract.spark_output_order: Preserve every row in collect order. Compare by row_id where present, otherwise as a multiset; do not add ORDER BY to the query under test.
comparison_contract.existing_frozen_references: Reuse the unchanged rng-one-partition-spark.jsonl for the three original direct/CONCAT queries; do not overwrite or recapture those references.
